{{Top|leg}}
The '''motivator booster''' was a module that linked into the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Motivator/Legends|motivators]], increasing their output drastically. A marked improvement could have been seen with even the most sluggish droids.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
